The idea is inspired by the Coder Buddy project , an AI-powered coding assistant built with LangGraph that behaves like a multi -agent development team capable of converting a prompt into a working project file -by-file. For example, a user could type: “Build a calculator web app with add, subtract, multiply and divide buttons.” codebasics. io The system will automatically plan the architecture, create required files, and generate code for the application. Many finance and operations teams often see a charge in a credit card statement, invoice, or expense report and want a quick explanation. In this project you will build an AI assistant where a user uploads a financial document screenshot or PDF and asks a question like “Why was this charge deducted?” codebasics. io codebasics. io The system uses vision + document extraction + retrieval + reasoning to understand the document and explain the charge. What You ’ll build • Upload a screenshot of a credit card statement, invoice, receipt or expense report • Extract fields such as vendor name, line item, subtotal, tax, total amount and billing date • Use a vision -capable LLM to understand the document layout and identify the charge • Retrieve supporting context such as prior invoices or billing policies using a vector database • Generate a grounded answer explaining the reason for the charge
